description: Credentials for asking FedEx and UPS where a package is. Everything here is off until a System Manager fills it in and turns it on.

fields.description: When on, ERPNext asks FedEx and UPS for the status of the tracking numbers on purchase orders: about every two hours on its own, and whenever someone presses Refresh. Off: tracking numbers can still be added and their carrier links still work, but nobody asks the carriers anything.
fields.label: Ask Carriers for Package Status

fields.options: Each carrier also needs its own switch on and an API client from its developer site: developer.fedex.com (a project with the Track API) and developer.ups.com (an app with the Tracking product). Start on Sandbox, then switch to Production with the production keys. See carrier_tracking/README.md.

fields.description: Sandbox keys only work on Sandbox, and production keys only on Production.
fields.label: FedEx Environment

fields.description: The project's Secret Key. Stored encrypted.

fields.description: Sandbox is UPS's Customer Integration Environment (CIE). Its keys and production keys are the same app, but CIE answers with test data.
